menus.note:
NOTE(s):
* 絵コンテ・演出 (Storyboard/Episode Director) is credited as just 演出 in the credits. For the sake of my sanity I will just credit it as 絵コンテ・演出.
* On that note, whenever the Storyboard role is split, it's never explicitly credited, but instead is merged into the Episode Director credit. I heavily disagree with that approach so I'll just include the Storyboard credit anyways.
* All the BANK credits are just credited under Key Animation (原画) in the credits, but is usually placed between the regular KA staff and the Toei Phils. staff.
* 2nd Key Animation (第二原画) is credited as just 原画, just split off from the regular KA staff.

The only credits missing are the directors for the OP and ED's...
